method: Web primary-source research plus independent visual comparison of local and exact official product artwork. Generic OEM supplier candidates stay unresolved.

reviews.evidence: Manufacturer page uses the identical full title, length 1500 mm, SKU family 12.003.**. Independently viewed official full-resolution veslo.png matches the catalog photograph: same two-paddle arrangement, silver shafts, handle shapes, oarlock position/orange button, blade grooves, and embossed KOLIBRI on blade. Attribution is based on matching source artwork plus exact manufacturer title, rather than generic paddle shape.
reviews.reason: User requested category-only treatment for outdoor items and targets rather than brand enrichment; primary research retained for reference.

reviews.evidence: Catalog photo shows CRPIII-145 family label and generic filling assembly, but no confidently readable retail brand. Official Acecare and Alsafe pages both use CRPIII-145-6.8-30-T designation for 6.8 L/300 bar cylinders.
reviews.reason: The visible designation is shared across manufacturers and identifies a cylinder specification, not an exclusive brand. Need cylinder maker label/certificate or supplier invoice.

reviews.evidence: PortAir accessories catalog contains the exact title and original image filename. Downloaded direct supplier image is available. PortAir says it manufactures PCP pumps/compressors and related accessories, including OEM cooperation. The local photo has no maker mark on the pump; LEADER printing is on the power cable, not proof of pump brand.
reviews.reason: Exact source-photo origin establishes a supplier candidate, but generic/OEM item has no product-level brand confirmation. Do not assign PORTAIR or cable manufacturer automatically.

reviews.evidence: PortAir catalog contains the original exact image filename and matching 1.6 Feet/63MPa hose listing. Generic unmarked hose in local photo; supplier offers OEM manufacture.
reviews.reason: PORTAIR is a source supplier candidate. No exclusive model, packaging or retail brand on this generic hose confirms the actual stocked brand.

reviews.evidence: PortAir catalog has original exact image filename for its 300 BAR DIN kit with 1.6 feet microbore hose. Local kit is unmarked and manufacturer offers OEM products.
reviews.reason: Source supplier candidate is found, but generic component assembly has no product-level brand confirmation.

reviews.evidence: PortAir catalog has original exact image filename for the second 300 BAR DIN kit. Local image shows generic unmarked assembly, supplier does OEM.
reviews.reason: Do not convert supplier/image origin to a confirmed retail brand without packaging or invoice.

reviews.evidence: Manufacturer Jinhua Zhongfa Machinery Manufacture Co., Ltd. publishes SF-C001 with matching 12AH/12V battery, speed 4.8km/h, thrust 11lbf/5kgf, depth 20m, runtime 1h and weight 11kg. However it gives a 150W motor versus the catalog 90W. No retail brand mark is legible in local photograph.
reviews.reason: Model/specification conflict and no retail branding. Manufacturer/supplier name alone cannot safely become the stocked product brand. Need rating label/packaging.

reviews.evidence: Independently viewed official Hatsan magazine.webp is the same original photograph used in the catalog: two machined metal rotary magazines in identical angles, with exactly the same loose-pellet arrangement below. Manufacturer page identifies magazines as Hatsan airgun accessories. Title specifies 10-shot/4.5mm. Attribution is to exact manufacturer artwork, not just compatible shape.
reviews.reason: Exact official manufacturer accessory-photo identity supports HATSAN. Do not infer additional compatible rifle models from this.

reviews.evidence: Catalog combines the exact official Hatsan Target #1 and #2 artwork, with identical stacked-sheet angles, 5-bull layout and 10 meter (33 feet) Air Rifle Target legend on #1, plus matching numbered concentric #2 artwork. reviews.reason: User requested category-only treatment for outdoor items and targets rather than brand enrichment; primary research retained for reference.

reviews.evidence: Local image shows five generic steel scope rings of varying heights. No maker mark or model code visible. Reviewed Hatsan official accessory/mount listing; no exact image/model confirmation found. Searches by original filename, Georgian title and steel Weaver ring descriptions did not establish manufacturer.
reviews.reason: Weaver describes mounting interface here and must not be assumed to be brand. Need brand mark/packaging or exact stock code.

reviews.evidence: Inspected photo shows two generic leather-looking piston/seal components with no branding or dimensions. Searches by exact original image basename and Georgian product title produced no maker/model identification.
reviews.reason: No unique identifying model or mark. Need physical dimensions, compatible rifle model and supplier/packaging details; compatibility alone is not proof of maker.
